data.title: Nations seek reset at UN talks as nature goals off track
data.description: YEREVAN - Nearly 200 nations are gathering in Armenia on Monday for critical negotiations as governments come under pressure to salvage a landmark nature pact whose goals are slipping out of reach.

data.title: Rubio seeks to strengthen US foothold in Central Asia
data.description: SAMARKAND, Uzbekistan - US Secretary of State Marco Rubio launches into talks on Monday with key Central Asian states before heading to India on a tour to a region with vast natural resources and China as a key competitor.

data.title: Second day of street clashes in Milan
data.description: MILAN (ITALY) - Youths and police clashed for a second day Sunday in Milan, where mostly black-clad vandals hurled bottles, ransacked stores, and destroyed property around the central Duomo plaza.

data.title: Trump backs ally Netanyahu ahead of Israel's tight election
data.description: JERUSALEM - US President Donald Trump on Sunday endorsed his ally Benjamin Netanyahu before Israel's close-fought parliamentary election on October 27, providing a boost to the veteran prime minister's bid to win a new mandate.

data.title: Venezuela opposition alliance reaffirms Nobel laureate Machado as leader
data.description: CARACAS - An alliance of Venezuelan opposition parties on Sunday reaffirmed exiled Nobel Peace Prize laureate Maria Corina Machado as its leader, increasing pressure on interim authorities to allow her return.

data.title: Albanian PM refuses to quit as violent protests enter sixth day
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Albanian police fired water cannon and tear gas Sunday as violent anti-government protests entered a sixth day and Prime Minister Edi Rama rejected demonstrators' demands that he resign.

data.title: Alberta separatists rally ahead of independence vote
data.description: EDMONTON (CANADA) - Supporters of Alberta's independence from Canada gathered Saturday in the provincial capital to urge residents to vote in favor of holding a future referendum on the issue.

data.title: Ukraine sets Saint Petersburg refinery ablaze in large-scale drone attack
data.description: SAINT PETERSBURG (RUSSIA) - Ukraine hit Saint Petersburg with a large-scale drone attack, causing fires at an oil refinery and depot, Moscow said Sunday, as Kyiv accused Russia of violating Donald Trump's "energy ceasefire" dozens of times and leaving tens of thousands without power.

data.title: Pope addresses crowd in Vatican after cancer surgery
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV addressed thousands of people in St Peter's Square on Sunday, smiling and saying he would resume work "gradually" in his first major public appearance since undergoing lung cancer surgery.

data.title: Russia-US diesel deal delivery to take 15-20 days: Russia
data.description: MOSCOW - Shipping Russian diesel to the US market will take 15 to 20 days once contracts are signed, a senior Russian official said in an interview broadcast Sunday, though a date for that signing has yet to be announced.

data.title: France counts cost of violent protests, 1,800 arrested
data.description: PARIS - France was reeling on Sunday from widespread damage caused in violent protests on Saturday that saw 1,800 people arrested, a historic town hall torched and widespread looting.

data.title: 'Never seen anything like it': mass looting grips Paris
data.description: PARIS - Smashing shop windows and snatching boxes of goods, migrant looters poured into stores across the French capital on Saturday, facing no resistance from authorities as nationwide protests degenerated into violence.

data.title: Japan to launch historic round-trip mission to Mars moon
data.description: TOKYO - Japanese scientists are readying a mission to Mars's moons to retrieve samples that could help unlock the origins of the Solar System and life on Earth, in what aims to be the first round trip to the Martian region.

data.title: Israeli settlers attack European diplomats, beat French mayor
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israeli settlers on Saturday attacked a convoy of European diplomats in the West Bank and beat up a visiting French mayor, witnesses said, a day after an American photographer was similarly set upon as violence escalates ahead of bitterly fought elections.

data.title: Town hall in Limoges 'largely lost' to blaze set during French protests
data.description: LIMOGES (FRANCE) - The town hall in the French city of Limoges was "largely lost" to a fire set by masked protesters on Saturday, the top regional official told AFP.

data.title: US goes on the offensive in central Asia
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - It's dealmaking time: despite the roiling geopolitical tensions embroiling Washington on several fronts, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio heads to Central and South Asia late Saturday to boost commercial ties -- and gain an edge over Russia and China.

data.title: Albanian capital sees fifth straight day of violent clashes
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Albania's capital saw violent clashes for a fifth straight day on Saturday as police fired rubber bullets on protesters demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, who pledged to listen to their concerns.

data.title: Four more Ebola cases detected in Kenya, bringing total to seven
data.description: NAIROBI - Kenya has confirmed four new Ebola cases, the health ministry said Saturday, including another relative of the first victim and three healthcare workers who treated him.

data.title: Pope Leo leaves hospital five days after cancer surgery
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV left hospital on Saturday to return to the Vatican, five days after his lung cancer surgery.

data.title: Fifth day of violent clashes in Albanian capital
data.description: TIRANA - Albania’s capital saw clashes for a fifth straight day Saturday as protesters demanded the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, who pledged to listen to their criticism.

data.title: Indian ‘cockroach’ party founder freed from detention
data.description: NEW DELHI - Cockroach Janata Party founder Abhijeet Dipke was released from detention on Saturday, a day after his arrest during a police crackdown on protests against the election authority.

data.title: France faces day of cost-of-living protests
data.description: PARIS - French authorities detained dozens on Saturday at the start of nationwide protests against the cost of living, in what is likely to be a key indicator of the social climate heading toward elections to replace President Emmanuel Macron.

data.title: Pope returning to Vatican after cancer surgery
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV was preparing on Saturday to leave the Rome hospital where he has been recovering from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican said, after doctors deemed him “fit for discharge”.

data.title: Haze triggers highest-level alert in parts of Southeast Asia
data.description: SINGAPORE - Fires in Indonesia that have sent toxic smoke disrupting daily life across Southeast Asia has triggered the highest-level alert by the regional bloc’s meteorological monitor.

data.title: Tokyo hosts second round of US-Myanmar talks
data.description: TOKYO - Representatives of the United States and Myanmar’s military-backed government held talks in Tokyo last week, people familiar with ​the matter said, their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up re-engagement with the generals it ‌shunned after their 2021 coup.

data.title: Tokyo hosts second round of US-Myanmar talks
data.description: TOKYO - Representatives of the United States and Myanmar’s military-backed government held talks in Tokyo last week, people familiar with ​the matter said, their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up re-engagement with the generals it ‌shunned after their 2021 coup.

data.title: Trump waives key Russia-related sanctions and tariffs
data.description: WASHINGTON - President Donald Trump has waived key Russia-related US sanctions and tariffs days before they were to take effect under a law he signed last month, including duties on the country’s goods and penalties for buying its oil and gas.

data.title: Fiji village restores dying fishery with coral planting
data.description: NAIDIRI - It had been decades since sharks last patrolled the reef off the coast of Fiji’s Naidiri Village, but they returned this year following a community-led effort to protect the fishery and plant thousands of corals.

data.title: Japan reports record number of foreign residents
data.description: TOKYO - Japan has registered a record number of foreigners living in the country this year despite growing anti-immigration sentiment, as the country grapples with problems caused by an ageing and shrinking population.

data.title: North Korea reports test of AI-assisted torpedo system
data.description: SEOUL - North Korea has tested a “new-type” precision-guided torpedo system that uses artificial intelligence for target detection and guidance, state media reported on Saturday, as the nuclear-armed country steps up weapons testing.

data.title: UN climate panel fails to agree date for global warming update
data.description: PARIS - The UN's IPCC climate panel failed after a week of tough talks to reach an agreement on when to release its next report on global warming, the senior French envoy at the talks said Friday.

data.title: UN climate panel fails to agree date for global warming update: envoy
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - The UN's IPCC climate panel failed after a week of tough talks to reach an agreement on when to release its next report on global warming, the senior French envoy at the talks said Friday.

data.title: Bend grieves after mass shooting: 'Who would do this to little kids?'
data.description: BEND (UNITED STATES) - Kristen Vanetsky and her family moved to Bend, Oregon, after a shooting in their New Mexico neighborhood, choosing Silver Rail elementary for her grandson because they considered it safer.

data.title: 'Great hero' praised for saving lives in Oregon school shooting
data.description: BEND (UNITED STATES) - The "hero" who shot dead a teenage gunman after he had already killed three children and a teacher at an elementary school in the US state of Oregon was named Friday by his brother.

data.title: Macron calls for calm amid fears of violence at France protests
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - President Emmanuel Macron called for calm on the eve of nationwide cost-of-living protests Saturday that authorities fear could lead to a violent escalation of weeks of student demonstrations.
